fusions.name: Hurled Stake
fusions.desc: Throws a sharpened stake up to 7 tiles. It deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Cudgelwork
fusions.desc: Swings a club with a nail driven through it across a cone 2.5 tiles ahead. The swing deals 8 damage to everything it catches and leaves each target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Longer Than It Looks
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Whittled Branch
fusions.desc: Conjures a branch stripped and sharpened to a tip. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
